LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE FUTURE TIME USING WILL/ SHALL.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense Future Time using will/ shall.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense Future Time using will/ shall., part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Which words do we use to show future time? 2. How do you tell the time something happened?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense Future Time using will/ shall. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: Interacting with digital devices as learners watch signed videos or a video with closed captions, offline or online to identify

sentences featuring future time.

• Creativity and Imagination: Making observations as learners make predictions about (events, weather) among others using will and shall.

Values:
Love: Sharing as learners use computers, tablets or mobile phones to observe signed audio visual materials.

Link to other Subjects:
